function: DDPG sets BS beamforming, artificial-noise covariance and UAV-borne RIS phase shifts to maximize worst-case secrecy rate; a DNN predicts user and eavesdropper positions as extra state (pp. 3-4).
system: UAV-borne passive reflecting RIS with 8-64 elements, BS with 4 antennas, single-antenna vehicular users (20-120) and 3 eavesdroppers; 2 GHz carrier (pp. 2, 4).
method: Deep reinforcement learning: DDPG actor-critic fed with positions from a supervised DNN predictor; centralized training with replay buffer, decentralized execution (pp. 3-4).
data_channel: Custom simulator: Rician A2G channels with Doppler (path-loss exponent 1.8, Rician factor 10), inaccurate-CSI model, moving vehicles; no dataset or measurement (pp. 2, 4).
test_conditions: One simulated environment with moving VUs; sweeps over RIS size, UAV height, BS power, number of VUs, VU speed and wind; no train-test shift stated (pp. 4-6).
baselines: Non-learned: SCA with majorization-minimization [19], alternating optimization, fixed RIS without UAV. Learned: PPO [13], SAC [11], DQN, DDPG without localization (p. 4).
metrics: Worst-case secrecy rate, QoS satisfaction level, beam alignment error, DNN position prediction accuracy, episodes to convergence, number of mathematical operations (pp. 4-6).
complexity: Number of mathematical operations: 4540 for the DDPG and 3661 for the position DNN at N=80 VUs, B=4, K=10; formula given (p. 4).
q1_support: p. 4: "a Rician factor of 10"; custom Rician A2G fading with Doppler (p. 2), and no 3GPP TR 38.901, QuaDRiGa, DeepMIMO or measured data is used.
q2_support: p. 5: "a fast-varying environment by varying maximum speed of VUs"; the paper only sweeps parameters and never says a trained model is tested on a setting absent from training.
q3_support: p. 4: "Successive Convex Approximation" (SCA-MM) and "perform alternating optimization" are non-learned; p. 4: "PPO-based beamforming and AN setting [13]" and "SAC-based beamforming and AN optimization [11]" are earlier learned methods, compared on secrecy rate in Figs. 6-11.
q4_support: p. 4: "the total number of performed mathematical operations is 4540" for the DDPG and 3661 for the DNN at N = 80.
q5_support: p. 4: "pathloss exponent of 1.8, and a Rician factor of 10"; channels come from the authors' own simulator, and no code or data link, DOI or public dataset is given.
notes: Area 6 chosen over 3 by the tie-break order: learned beam and RIS control of an aerial UAV-borne RIS link; area 3 also fits. The DNN position prediction is only an auxiliary state of the DDPG, so the work is not excluded as localization. The UAV trajectory is taken from ref. [20], not learned. Fixed RIS without UAV is not counted as the non-learned baseline (its method is unclear); SCA-MM and alternating optimization are. The complexity example uses K=10 eavesdroppers while the simulation uses K=3. Figures read from the page images of pp. 4-6.
